title: Azure DevOps environments and their checks (one file per environment group)
description: A group is one stage of the system, such as dev or prod, with its base environment '<system> - <group>' and suffixed variants '<system> - <group> - <suffix>'. Every check that is absent or disabled must not exist on the environment; checks of other types are left alone.

system.description: Prefix of every environment name, for example 'shop'.

group.description: Environment group, for example 'dev' or 'prod'. No hyphens: ' - ' separates the parts of a name.

policy.description: Rules every environment of this group must follow, unless the environment has a policyExemption.

requireFourEyes.description: Every environment needs an approval check in which the person who started the run cannot approve it.

requireBranchControl.description: Every environment needs a branch control check.

requireExclusiveLock.description: Every environment needs an exclusive lock.

security.description: Applied once, when Set-Environments.ps1 creates an environment. Role drift on existing environments is not detected.

administrators.description: Groups or users that get the Administrator role on a new environment, for example '[shop]\Release Administrators'.

removeCreatorRole.description: Remove the Administrator role Azure DevOps gives the identity that created the environment.

policyExemption.description: Why this environment does not follow the group policy. Required to deviate; reviewed like code.

exclusiveLock.description: Only one run at a time may use the environment; later runs wait.

branchControl.description: Only runs from these branches may use the environment.

allowedBranches.description: Full refs such as 'refs/heads/main', wildcards such as 'refs/heads/release/*', or '*'. The API stores them as one comma-separated string.

verifyBranchProtection.description: Also require that the branch has a branch policy.

approval.description: Manual approval before a run may use the environment.

approvers.description: Users (e-mail address) or groups ('[project]\Group name'), resolved to identities at run time.

minRequiredApprovers.description: How many approvers must approve. 1 for 'any one of'.

requesterCannotBeApprover.description: The four-eyes principle: whoever started the run cannot approve it.

executionOrder.description: anyOrder or inSequence (approvers approve in the listed order).
